changelog:
0.4.0

  • Custom date range, Add Stats and Create Alert.
  • Email reports (Pro) and alerts (Pro+).
  • Agency white-label email and PDF reports.
  • World map, visitor full history.
  • Many new store, customer, inventory, search, 404 and blog reports.
  • llms.txt generator (Pro+).
  • Faster reports on big sites.

0.3.9

  • Long lists scroll inside their card (mouse wheel / touch).

0.3.8

  • Button click tracking is part of Pro+ and Agency.

0.3.7

  • Clearer navigation flows with page names and most common journeys.
  • Form tracking by type (contact, checkout, account, newsletter) with settings; works with custom forms.

0.3.6

  • Sales include every paid order, incl. custom statuses.
  • Sales by source uses WooCommerce Order Attribution as a fallback.
  • Settings → Order check.

0.3.5

  • "Open report" / "View more" buttons on data cards (top and bottom).
  • Live activity shows which button each visitor clicked.
  • New reports: Button Clicks by Page, Avg. Time on Page.

0.3.4

  • Live activity: "View more" popup with full, live-updating list.

0.3.3

  • Real-time page updates every second without refreshing.
  • Live activity shows add to cart, checkout and purchases; recent visitors show their shopping stage.

0.3.2

  • Sales now include orders with custom statuses such as Shipped and Delivered.

0.3.1

  • Small improvements.

0.3.0

  • Pro: button clicks, new vs returning visitors, time on page.
  • Pro+: conversion funnel, visitor snapshot, abandoned carts, device/browser/OS report.
  • Pro+: navigation flows, form submissions, marketing & AI visibility, email tracking, Microsoft Clarity recordings, accounting, All Reports + CSV.
  • Agency: insights and benchmarks.

0.2.0

  • Pro: page visits, entry & exit pages, bounce rate, session duration.
  • Pro: traffic sources — Google / Facebook organic vs ads, AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity…).
  • Pro: device type, countries, real-time recent visitors & live activity.
  • Pro: WooCommerce sales, orders, top products, sales by source.
  • License key activation.

0.1.4

  • Cleaner settings page.
  • "Delete all plugin data" on by default.
  • Optional feedback when deactivating.

0.1.3

  • Tracker no longer blocked by common ad-block lists (some visitors were missing).
  • More precise bot detection.

0.1.2

  • Dashboard → Updates → "Check again" fetches the latest version immediately.

0.1.1

  • Live visitors appear right away on sites using LiteSpeed Cache, WP Rocket, Autoptimize (tracker excluded from JS delay).
  • Admin live view refreshes every 10 seconds.

0.1.0

  • First release: live visitors + countries.
